description:
When to use: the caller wants to know whether the funds in this portfolio hold the same names, so the book is less diversified than the fund count suggests.

    Inputs: portfolio_id from list_portfolios. The caller's token is the owner scope. Do not pass a user id or a symbol list. The route looks through the funds on that portfolio.

    What comes back: the route JSON, unchanged. pairs names two funds and overlap_weight, the share of the left fund that is also in the right fund, by weight. shared names a holding counted once, with its portfolio weight. A fund with no holdings file is named in missing and is not a zero overlap. A portfolio the token does not own is the same not-found answer as a missing id.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID from list_portfolios

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_portfolio_fund_overlap
title: Get portfolio fund overlap
